component.name: org.nuxeo.labs.dashboard.webresources
component.documentation:
Registers a plain HTML resource with the Web UI bundle so that Web UI loads it at startup and picks up the nuxeo-slot-content it declares.
The type="import" attribute is mandatory: nuxeo.war/ui/config.jsp only lists resources whose type matches "import". Without it, ResourceDescriptor would infer type "html" from the file name and the resource would be silently dropped.
This route is used instead of the file name convention (nuxeo.war/ui/PACKAGE-NAME.html) because the convention ties the file name to the marketplace package name.
Do NOT add a require on org.nuxeo.web.ui here. Inside a component, require names a COMPONENT, and no component is named org.nuxeo.web.ui: that string is only the bundle symbolic name. The component would stay pending, and since nuxeo.start.strict defaults to true the server would refuse to start. It is not needed anyway: WebResourceManagerImpl resolves the web-ui bundle lazily at read time, and an append="true" contribution is never lost whatever its registration order. Web UI's own reference contribution has no require either. For bundle level ordering, the right place is Nuxeo-Require in META-INF/MANIFEST.MF.
